dialogues.speaker: Kweku
dialogues.text: Want to give it a try? The saurians are ready and raring to go.

response.speaker: Kweku
response.text: Come on then! I'm sure you won't be disappointed.

choices.text: I wish I could play longer.

response.speaker: Kweku
response.text: Seriously? To be honest, before setting up at the Children of Echoes, I was really worried that no one would be interested...

response.speaker: Kweku
response.text: It wasn't that I had any particular concerns. It's just that when I look into those shiny saurian eyes, I can't help but be reminded of an old friend...

response.speaker: Kweku
response.text: It was such a good saurian... It was so lively, it practically bounced off the walls. If you weren't playing with it, it'd run in circles around you like a curious toddler.

response.speaker: Kweku
response.text: And then there's Miss Komina... There've been times I wouldn't have known what to do had it not been for her.

response.speaker: Kweku
response.text: But now we have your seal of approval, I feel so much better. People are sure to be interested now, and it's all thanks to you!

choices.text: People will be interested no matter what.

response.speaker: Kweku
response.text: Ahahahaha! Regardless, you've been a great help.

response.speaker: Kweku
response.text: Next time I come up with a new stage, you'll be the first person I ask to try it out.

choices.text: It's hard to say no to hanging out with a saurian.
I'll be sure to warm up first.

response.speaker: Kweku
response.text: Warming up before any form of exercise is the right thing to do... Come see me whenever you want to play. I'll be right here.
